_comment: Phase 4c over-fire stress corpus: ordinary sentences using a common word that collides with a dictionary-stress term, NO term intended. Any stress-term that appears after biasing is a false positive. Spans the zipf spectrum so we can see at what frequency the single-token gate starts/stops suppressing.
